description: The file defines the generic class 'OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult>' responsible for invoking requests on grain references within the Orleans framework. It manages a chain of filters and request invocation logic for grain calls.

classes.name: OutgoingCallInvoker<TResult>
classes.description: A class that manages the process of invoking a request on a grain reference, including filter processing and response handling.

methods.name: OutgoingCallInvoker
methods.description: Constructor initializing the invoker with grain reference, request, options, send method, and filters.

methods.name: Invoke
methods.description: Asynchronous method to execute the invocation considering the filter pipeline and ultimately sending the request.
